svg.title: Strict incremental parser latency by chunk size
svg.desc: Grouped bars compare complete-stream elapsed milliseconds for the public native ABI3 parser, direct native result API, and Python fallback across five payload shapes. Lower is better. Each panel has its own vertical scale.
svg.text: Strict incremental parsing by chunk size
Median elapsed milliseconds per complete stream · exact UTF-8 byte chunks · lower is better
